feature: Per-map initial-ready and manual resident resource inspector

behavior.captures: once per foreground load plus explicit manual refresh
behavior.retention: one initial and one manual snapshot, bounded 1024 inventory rows/type and 4096 preparation rows

limitations: No browser automation or real-device validation
Near-tier placement totals include unloaded/offscreen placements; not current rendered triangles
Resident snapshot includes prepared alternate LODs, templates and hidden pools
Known buffers and texture estimates are not total GPU/device RAM
Preparation ledger is not every actual Babylon loader read; network transfer remains unknown without evidence
No texture, LOD, combat or art resource changes
